title: Python plans pair typed checks with runtime evidence

task.prompt: Use /spec to change a Python plugin registry whose handlers are loaded through decorators and **kwargs; design the impact and verification plan.
task.fixture: isolated Python repo with pyright, pytest, testmon, decorators, and runtime plugin discovery

requirements.criterion: The design treats static Python references as a lower bound and includes runtime test/coverage selection plus a dynamic-dispatch gap statement.
Each behavior AC has an executable pytest/public-seam proof tied to an actually passed Python harness P# rather than only pyright or grep output.

A mutation-based Pyright impact probe compares baseline and candidate diagnostics, excludes pre-existing or line-shift-only diagnostics from mutation impact, treats only new diagnostics as typed candidates rather than behavior proof, and preserves any independent repository typecheck gate.

graders.procedure: Parse the receipt/issue evidence mappings and assert they contain baseline-delta typed analysis, exclude pre-existing and line-shift-only diagnostics from mutation impact without relaxing an independent repository typecheck gate, classify new diagnostics as candidates rather than behavior proof, separate typed/structural/runtime evidence, include public-seam behavior tests, and state the dynamic gap; fail a static-only or raw-all-diagnostics plan.
